page.layout: One printed page. Top centre: page number 68, then the running title block (a division opener, so no running head). Full-width heading ARITHMETICAE PARS ALTERA, then CAPUT XI with its subtitle. Below that, a large bracketed diagram of the ratio classes, with vertical and horizontal labels and braces, plus the Caput XI and Caput XII cross-references. At the bottom right, the catchword ARITH-.

main_text.head: ARITHMETICAE PARS ALTERA.
CAPUT XI.
De Rationis speciebus.
main_text.l: E. Altera pars Arithmeticae versatur in comparatione uel
Species, inaequalitatis enim ratio alia est CAP. XI.
Minoris. Haec in totidem formas diuidua est.
Species utra tractatio, in qua consideranda earum CAP. XII.

page.notes: The diagram is a tree of braces; levels are approximate readings of the depth of each box. Several labels are set vertically (Terminorum, & dicitur Ratio, quarum altera; Inaequalitatis, attenditur uel secundum; Quotum, atq; hic occurrunt uel; Prima; Maioris), and their reading order follows the drawing. The word "Suppar ticularis" is split across lines in the print. The printed "Subductio" is read as Subdu&tio-like shape and marked as seen. Right edge shows a neighbouring page, not transcribed.
